title: E-Commerce Test Suite
description: Complete e-commerce automation with Page Object Model. Covers login, product search with filters, cart quantity management, checkout with payment gateway, empty cart validation, and item removal. 5 test cases with cross-browser support.

title: Banking Application Test Suite
description: Enterprise banking automation covering 2FA login, account summary verification, inter-account fund transfer, insufficient balance validation, bill pay scheduling, and transaction history with CSV export. 5 test cases with security-first approach.

title: Healthcare Application Test Suite
description: HIPAA-compliant healthcare portal automation for patient registration with insurance details, specialty appointment booking, appointment cancellation within policy, medical records access and download (Lab Results, Prescriptions, Visit Summaries), and prescription refill requests. 5 test cases.

title: CRM Test Suite
description: CRM sales pipeline automation for lead creation from web inquiries, lead-to-contact-and-deal conversion, deal progression through pipeline stages (Qualification to Closed Won), activity logging on contacts, and pipeline report export. 5 test cases covering full sales funnel.

title: Travel Booking Test Suite
description: Travel platform automation for flight search with multi-criteria filters and price sorting, round-trip booking with passenger details and extras (baggage, seat, meal), hotel search and booking, itinerary modification, and online check-in with boarding pass download. 5 test cases.

title: E-Learning Platform Test Suite
description: Education platform automation for course catalog browsing with category/level filters, course enrollment with payment, module-by-module progress tracking, quiz taking with score verification, failed quiz retake flow, and certificate download upon grade achievement. 5 test cases.
